question: How much did Atlas (theatlas.ai) raise in its latest funding round?

hits.title: Accounting tech startup Atlas raises $6 million in round co-led by Accel, Stellaris - The Economic Times
hits.snippet: Accounting tech startup Atlas raises $6 million in round co-led by Accel, Stellaris - The Economic Times ... Atlas raises $6 million in ... led by Acc ... Singapore-headquartered accounting tech startup Atlas has raised $6 million in a funding round co-led by Accel and Stellaris Venture Partners, as it looks to expand its artificial intelligence (AI)-native platform and scale operations in North America.The company said the funds will be used to enhance its AI platform, grow its network of partner accounting firms, and accelerate go-to-market efforts.Founded in 2025 by Arpit Maheshwari and Jagmal Singh, Atlas is building an AI-led platform for independent accounting firms, aiming to help them scale operations without adding headcount.

The company’s flagship software products, recognized for their unique features, are offered at competitive pricing points designed to appeal to a broad spectrum of users. B2B partnerships also play a critical role in generating revenue, where the company collaborates with retailers and wholesalers to extend its market reach. Overall, this structured transaction model enables the company to sustain its growth while delivering value to its clients and end users. In April 2026, Atlas raised USD 6. ... 000 mn in Seed funding co-led by returning investors Accel and Stellaris Venture Partners. The company will utilize this funding to develop technology aimed at automating accounting tasks, which will assist small and independent firms in increasing their capacity without the need for additional hires.
